alice@example.com.title: Path to Cloud Architect
alice@example.com.description: A structured 24-month learning roadmap to transition from full-stack developer to Cloud Architect.

steps.title: Master Linux & Networking
steps.description: Build foundational infrastructure knowledge including Linux administration, TCP/IP, DNS, and load balancing.

steps.title: AWS Cloud Fundamentals
steps.description: Complete AWS Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect Associate certifications.

steps.title: Container Orchestration
steps.description: Master Docker and Kubernetes for containerized application deployment and management.

steps.title: Infrastructure as Code
steps.description: Learn Terraform and Pulumi for declarative infrastructure provisioning.

steps.title: Architecture Patterns
steps.description: Study distributed systems design patterns: microservices, event-driven, CQRS, saga.

steps.title: Certification & Job Prep
steps.description: Get AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification and prepare for system design interviews.
